correctness.rationale: For GAlex(Gamma,theta), every right translation has the exact form R_{theta(y)^(-1)y} theta. The source proves those displacement elements generate all Gamma=Q8 x C7, so Inn(P7)=R_Gamma semidirect <theta> with trivial intersection and order 56*6=336. The factorwise action splits this as (Q8 semidirect C3) x (C7 semidirect C2)=T* x D14. The source orbit group contains f with f^6=-1, hence order 12, while exact factor orders exclude order 12 in T* x D14. The bundled exhaustive permutation-group replay independently confirms order 336, displacement order 56, stabilizer order 6, and absence/presence of order-12 elements.

value.rationale: The recent realization paper places two natural order-336 groups beside the same order-56 quandle: an intrinsic symmetry group one might expect from the quandle and a geometric orbit group governing the circle-action construction. Showing they are nonisomorphic prevents a genuine structural conflation and pinpoints what extra extension data the geometry carries. The identification also gives a reusable exact description of the inner group, its regular displacement subgroup, and identity stabilizer.
